title: fix(eval): keep incomplete negative evidence out of NoUpdate (HOLD)
body:
## Purpose

Keep Hepta's external task objective, predicted consequences, behavior, critic, independently observed results and public reward contract separate. Missing authorization, complete costs, outcome evidence, provenance or independence must stay Unknown. Complete evaluated NoUpdate must remain distinct from insufficient evidence, and deterministic fraud requires the original authorized challenge process.

## Current review state

**Draft; qualification=false. Real qualified authorized A → original Training owner → independent B → Adopt or complete NoUpdate → new C → actual daemon and Root cold-recovery chains: 0.**

The original source head of this PR remains `cc57c7198db6293ccca562253c42fffbe2a04633`. No merge, deployment or activation was performed.

The latest verified evidence checkpoint is [`c3cfa06f`](https://github.com/TrillionniumFoundation/hepta-private-ci/commit/c3cfa06f76fc5cabe4535866fd88c21d4831420b), on `codex/utility-eval-evidence-20261112-36fa`. Its [current README](https://github.com/TrillionniumFoundation/hepta-private-ci/blob/c3cfa06f76fc5cabe4535866fd88c21d4831420b/qa/evidence/utility-evaluation-20261112-36fa/README.md) preserves earlier checkpoint text and original failures.

### Actual history closure

The approved history stage actually completed with job `1a1d52e0d88-392-784`, exit 0. Root independently reconstructed **61 complete files / 8,301,563 bytes**, including all 55 required historical originals. The 17 exact writes, original 83 part-read responses (including the failed helper read and same-version continuation), 177 fixed-file read responses, dispatch and normal completion are retained.

The complete set of **755 raw originals / 38,963,673 bytes** is durably encoded in 73 bounded parts. Root performed actual Git full GET of every part plus all three archive metadata records, decoded the bounded archive and replayed the 457 required inputs. [Root replay and archive closure](https://github.com/TrillionniumFoundation/hepta-private-ci/tree/c3cfa06f76fc5cabe4535866fd88c21d4831420b/qa/evidence/utility-evaluation-20261112-36fa/root-history-stage-complete-review-v1) retain exact pins and limitations. No historical path was repaired or replaced. These facts establish transport/readback closure, not utility or source qualification.

### Exact source request remains Unknown

A separate source-only approval `9a48727adf7f73ee6adf8d45b567db3000a83c5f` bound exact request `eb4658e231aac54f226a78585d647e2bab8aa6e1`, target `b6084394a4a38ab495c16eaba09e879f04a96f8e` / tree `8ebb37e523ad3932a58cf016af0a9f4e0eeb6638`, and key `hepta-utility-36fa-final-source-gates-b608-v2`. It did not authorize E1/E2/E3 or the native 14-phase run.

That request was submitted once. Its original response was MCP timeout `-32603`, without a job id. One exact fixed RESULT-path read reported the path unavailable. A separately approved bounded metadata lookup used two calls in one snapshot: pending/incomplete with zero job rows, then `durable inventory source entry bound exceeded`. No task identity or authoritative status was obtained.

**Admission, execution, physical source preservation and all source-gate results remain Unknown.** This is neither a gate failure nor proof of non-execution/NotApplied. H is stopped; there was no second start, fresh key, refreshed inventory, diagnostic executable or other-job probe. The [Root reconciliation review](https://github.com/TrillionniumFoundation/hepta-private-ci/blob/c3cfa06f76fc5cabe4535866fd88c21d4831420b/qa/evidence/utility-evaluation-20261112-36fa/source-unknown-reconciliation-root-v1/ROOT_UNKNOWN_RECONCILIATION_REVIEW.json) links the exact unmodified original responses. The earlier `65a` failed contract stays failed.

### Product source proposals

| Candidate | Scope | Validation limit |
| --- | --- | --- |
| E1 separate source branch `99fada80470f175ba14004ea9fcb006853c7d98f` | 19-path Root initial-generation/session/task custody assembly | Exact objects/tree/commit/ref read back; unformatted, uncompiled and unrun |
| E2 factory + refusal | Original Ready custody → same Q24 factory and explicit ReconciliationRequired refusal | Original owners/Source/Cell retained; static review only |
| E2 IPC packet `06dafdbdeb53eb5ccf6480993596bbb4d939f203` | Two fixed Task/Loan lanes; actual admission, Trace and private Receipt remain daemon-side; original Source/Cell custody stays Root | Full independent before/after and original Driver body review; no runtime proof |
| LanePurpose packet `69d6d5eda401ff59f7e89b1e659f77a431274248` | Three-file explicit private enum replacing new positional bool | Fixed wire/purpose set, owners and budgets unchanged |
| E3 first Root CLI `0dc5e98ff38ed0c4c4defe277d21a5cb90bae37b` | Actual original trust/model/issuer/registration construction path | Seven-path frozen source proposal |
| E3 late enrollment `388bfb3f3ab70e5f39d847c26d2d48daa2c7ead1` | Sealed two-right handoff, original listener, daemon connects after actual UID drop | Twenty-path frozen source proposal; five framing/deadline tests not run |

A reproducible **79-path composed source view** (50 new / 29 modified original paths) now includes E1, E2 factory/refusal/IPC/LanePurpose/ordinary handoff, and E3 first/late/explicit-receiver layers. [Root composition proof](https://github.com/TrillionniumFoundation/hepta-private-ci/blob/c3cfa06f76fc5cabe4535866fd88c21d4831420b/qa/evidence/utility-evaluation-20261112-36fa/root-product-composition-v3/PREQUALIFICATION_COMPOSITION_REVIEW.json) retains every known before-image and inverse. Root corrected the actual combined FLAGS length to 21 after both layers independently changed 19→20, keeping both flags. The [independent shared-entry review](https://github.com/TrillionniumFoundation/hepta-private-ci/blob/c3cfa06f76fc5cabe4535866fd88c21d4831420b/qa/evidence/utility-evaluation-20261112-36fa/root-product-composition-v3-shared-entry-peer-v1/REVIEW.json) separately verifies 21 flags, 14 distinct FD slots, actual UID-drop ordering and Task installation before V3/runtime. This remains uncompiled source, not a new source commit or full 79-file semantic/runtime result.

The 26-path ordinary handoff layer is frozen and [independently reviewed](https://github.com/TrillionniumFoundation/hepta-private-ci/blob/c3cfa06f76fc5cabe4535866fd88c21d4831420b/qa/evidence/utility-evaluation-20261112-36fa/e2-ordinary-handoff-independent-peer-v1/REVIEW.json). It reuses the original three mandatory host lanes plus two paired optional lanes and the same Task custody. Its complete 556,937-byte packet is retained in three bounded parts with exact Root Git readback. Four additional bootstrap/actual-Receipt mechanism tests are frozen and independently reviewed; none has run, and they are not included in the 79-path view. They do not qualify real IPC or process cold recovery.

E3's seven-file registration proposal is an isolated **E1 plus E3 projection**, not the final E2/E3 union: 650→666 boundaries, 451→470 protections, 24 caller additions across 18 existing rows, and 54→57 Root parents. Its complete 4,628,695-byte source packet was reconstructed from three actual Git-readback parts. [Final integration obligations](https://github.com/TrillionniumFoundation/hepta-private-ci/blob/c3cfa06f76fc5cabe4535866fd88c21d4831420b/qa/evidence/utility-evaluation-20261112-36fa/e3-registration-projection-v1/INTEGRATION_OBLIGATIONS.json) retain exact source identities, full-file guards, caller sets and native test selection.

The complete same-session Root CLI loader, dedicated Material readonly Source lane and final registration remain in progress. Material needs its own actual supervisor-provided actor/process/pidfd binding; daemon identity is not a substitute. The existing standalone E3 CLI opens an issuer and cannot simply be embedded beside an owned Task session. The new path must reuse the same retained issuer/session and absolute end. Existing Artifact/FinalUse/journal/witness state is opened through original constructors; cold recovery must reject missing/empty state, not initialize a replacement. An inherited stream connected while Root cannot be relabeled as the daemon. Dropping an outer await or losing a terminal response is not proof of joined work or NotApplied.

## Acceptance requirements that remain

1. Real A enters the original signed ordinary ingress, with actual Model, Selector, Version, Training and FinalUse owners. Missing owners continue to reject.
2. B is independently sourced and authorized; complete costs, task-distribution coverage, retention/rare/critical-task constraints and the strongest deployable comparison are evidenced. Different keys alone are insufficient for independence.
3. Adopt requires all benefit and hard gates. Complete NoUpdate retains the parent and honest-service payment semantics. Missing evidence stays Unknown. No deterministic-fraud outcome is manufactured from an engineering error or missing data.
4. New C actually consumes and reads back the adopted version or retained parent. Content roots identify bytes; access, licensing, original owner authority and actual use require their own evidence.
5. Daemon and Root actually terminate/restart and recover the same durable records. Same-process reopen and constructor tests do not meet this condition.
6. The exact complete candidate passes the original AGENTS/just/source/native gates, with no weakened filters, budgets, caller rules, UID/capability checks or tests. No full qualification result is currently established.
